items.title: Greg Abbott halts Texas data centers
items.summary: Axios reported that Texas Governor Greg Abbott directed PUCT and ERCOT to deny interconnection to data-center projects that fail to meet requirements while proposed projects are audited.

items.title: New Texas data center projects frozen until state audits them
items.summary: Texas Tribune reported that Abbott on August 3 ordered PUCT and ERCOT to audit all data centers seeking grid connection and that non-compliant projects must be denied; the audit covers energy, water, tax breaks, ownership and community impact.

items.title: Data center approvals in Texas halted until audits completed, Gov. Greg Abbott says
items.summary: AP reported Abbott announced a moratorium on data-center approvals until an audit is completed; ERCOT tracks more than 1,800 queue projects exceeding 474 GW, about five times the record peak, with roughly 90% of new power requests from data centers; ERCOT paused its Batch Zero review.

items.title: Facing an estimated 474 GW of interconnection requests, Texas hits pause on data centers
items.summary: Utility Dive reported ERCOT delayed the Batch Zero transmission planning study after Abbott's August 3 letter and plans to ask PUCT for a good-cause exemption to the timeline at its August 20 open meeting; queue requests total about 474 GW, more than five times ERCOT's record peak.

items.title: Texas Orders Statewide Audit of AI Data Center Projects
items.summary: Data Center Knowledge reported ERCOT will work with PUCT to implement the governor's directive including postponement of the Batch Zero transmission planning study; PUCT Chairman Thomas Gleeson endorsed the directive.

items.title: Abbott Orders Full Audit of Texas Data Center Interconnection Queue, Threatens to Deny Grid Access
items.summary: POWER Magazine reported the August 3 letter to PUCT Chairman Thomas Gleeson and ERCOT CEO Pablo Vegas, noting ERCOT's July 29 Senate testimony that the large-load interconnection queue has reached 474 GW, of which about 90% is data centers.

items.title: SpaceX earnings call: Musk says AI infrastructure to use Nvidia chips
items.summary: Axios reported Musk said on SpaceX's Q2 earnings call that SpaceX decided to build out AI infrastructure with Nvidia chips, citing Vera Rubin; no complete call transcript or GPU order was disclosed.

items.title: SpaceX ramps up Tesla Megapack purchases in Q2 to power its AI data centers
items.summary: CNBC reported SpaceX financial filings show $295 million of Tesla Megapack purchases in Q2 2026 (H1 total $329 million) to help power Colossus data centers near Memphis; Musk set a tentative target of 20 GW of power and cooling live online by end of next year, with about 15 GW at the power-plant level.

items.title: 抛弃AMD锁定英伟达，SpaceX独家采用英伟达芯片，自身股价却大跌13.6%
items.summary: 财闻/新浪财经转述马斯克电话会表态：SpaceX将独家使用英伟达芯片并预计明年获得较大比例GPU供货份额；Q2算力扩容至1.4GW，目标今年底2GW、2027年末10GW；Q2资本开支184亿美元，其中AI板块158亿美元。属自媒体转述，未获完整原始记录。

items.title: Anthropic 与初创公司 Volta 签订 100 亿美元算力采购协议，后者成立仅半年
items.summary: IT之家援引彭博社：Anthropic与成立数月的Volta Infra Holdings签订100亿美元、六年期算力采购协议；算力来自挪威Tydal由Bitdeer运营、水电供电并部署英伟达Vera Rubin的数据中心，容量133MW，分两阶段最迟2027年3月交付；Volta完成3亿美元融资（a16z、Altimeter领投，英伟达与Michael Dell参与），估值24亿美元，并设50亿美元芯片采购融资计划。

items.title: AI cloud startup Volta valued at $2.4 billion, announces $10 billion AI partnership
items.summary: Reuters reported Volta Infra said it raised funds at a $2.4 billion valuation and landed a $10 billion six-year contract; Bloomberg News reported the Nvidia-backed Volta's $10 billion cloud contract is with Anthropic, citing people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Anthropic signed a $10 billion computing deal with a months-old Nvidia-backed startup
items.summary: Quartz relayed Bloomberg reporting that Anthropic signed a six-year, $10 billion agreement to use computing capacity from Volta Infra Holdings, a months-old AI infrastructure startup backed by Nvidia; capacity is 133 MW powered by Vera Rubin chips.

items.title: Banks in talks to lend $15 billion for Anthropic data center backed by Google, WSJ reports
items.summary: Reuters relayed a Wall Street Journal report that data-center developer Nexus Data Centers is in advanced talks to raise $15 billion for a Texas campus tied to Anthropic, with Alphabet's Google offering financial guarantees and supplying chips.

items.title: AI基建债成了烫手山芋？大摩拟转售150亿美元数据中心银行贷款，在债券市场寻找接盘侠
items.summary: 《金融时报》报道，以摩根士丹利为首的银行财团计划把与得州Hubbard一处由谷歌提供资金支持、租赁给Anthropic的数据中心相关的150亿美元债务，在贷款提取后推向债券市场再融资；园区约2000英亩、开发商为Nexus Data Centers且仍在施工，谷歌TPU芯片融资另行安排，谷歌背书在完工后生效，预计债券为投机级，项目配建自有天然气发电。

items.title: 存储原厂完成2027全年产能分配，DRAM及HBM产能全数售罄
items.summary: 每日经济新闻援引业界消息：存储原厂已完成2027全年产能分配，三大厂DRAM与HBM产能全部售罄；NAND至2026年8月底前产能基本订完；无论是否签长协，买家均接受预付订金模式，印证2027年为存储最短缺年份的预期。

items.title: TrendForce: 2027年DRAM供給持續緊張，NVIDIA評估下調Rubin Ultra HBM配置
items.summary: TrendForce研究：DRAM供应短缺预计延续至2027年；因HBM4e验证与量产良率存在不确定性，NVIDIA自2026年三季度起并行评估Rubin Ultra的HBM4e 8hi、HBM4 12hi与8hi等替代配置，最终规格未定；2027年HBM位元出货量预计同比增长约50-60%，仍不足以满足需求增长。

items.title: Partners Group to become majority shareholder in data center power solutions provider AVK and accelerate future growth
items.summary: Partners Group announced it will become the majority shareholder of data-center power solutions provider AVK, planning an initial investment of more than USD 1 billion of equity supplemented by debt financing; AVK management retains a minority stake and expansion targets European data-center infrastructure demand.
